pages.title: Textbook page practice: Dagbok
pages.intro: This page belongs to the textbook drama. Use Andreas only as a diary-form model: dated news, events in order and past verbs.
pages.imageAlt: Textbook page 19, Dagbok, where Andreas writes about his secret and his first date
recallCues: Andreas introduces himself and says why he started a diary.
He describes his family and a woman he met a month ago.
They began dating last week; he wonders whether to tell Nora the truth.
He worries that Lena will be disappointed.
First date: he booked a table and waited for Nora.
They ate and drank, then went to the cinema.

lines.speaker: Andreas
lines.fi: Jag heter Andreas. Jag har ett hemligt liv så jag började skriva dagbok.
lines.en: My name is Andreas. I have a secret life, so I started writing a diary.

lines.speaker: Andreas
lines.fi: Jag har en fru som heter Lena och två söner, Jonas och Nils. Jag älskar min familj, men jag träffade en otroligt vacker kvinna för en månad sedan.
lines.en: I have a wife called Lena and two sons, Jonas and Nils. I love my family, but I met an incredibly beautiful woman a month ago.

lines.speaker: Andreas
lines.fi: Jag blev kär i henne direkt. Vi började dejta förra veckan. Hon vet ingenting om min familj. Borde jag berätta sanningen för Nora?
lines.en: I fell in love with her immediately. We started dating last week. She knows nothing about my family. Should I tell Nora the truth?

lines.speaker: Andreas
lines.fi: Dessutom blir Lena så besviken på mig. Hjälp!
lines.en: Besides, Lena will be so disappointed in me. Help!

lines.speaker: Andreas
lines.fi: Första dejt med Nora: Jag bokade bord på en fin restaurang. Jag kom 5 minuter tidigare och väntade på Nora. Hon kom inte i tid, hon var 5 minuter sen.
lines.en: First date with Nora: I booked a table at a nice restaurant. I arrived 5 minutes early and waited for Nora. She did not arrive on time; she was 5 minutes late.

lines.speaker: Andreas
lines.fi: Vi åt pasta och drack vin. Efter restaurangen gick vi på bio. Det var romantiskt.
lines.en: We ate pasta and drank wine. After the restaurant we went to the cinema. It was romantic.

listenQuestions.prompt: Why did Andreas start a diary?
listenQuestions.explanation: Jag har ett hemligt liv så jag började skriva dagbok.

listenQuestions.prompt: What did Andreas and Nora do after the restaurant?
listenQuestions.explanation: Efter restaurangen gick vi på bio.

naturalNotes.note: The page writes the ordinal with a figure; read it aloud as den första april.

naturalNotes.source: Borde jag berätta sanningen för Nora?
naturalNotes.natural: Ska jag berätta sanningen för Nora?
naturalNotes.note: Borde means should and appears fully in a later lecture. Ska jag …? is enough to produce now.

chunks: Efter restaurangen gick vi på bio.

hunt.label: Past-tense hunt
hunt.title: Find the event verbs the page marks in red.
hunt.instructions: Tap the marked past forms and connect each one to an event in the diary.
hunt.missHint: Look for what started or happened: började, träffade, bokade, väntade.

spots.rule: började: started; the next verb stays in the infinitive.
träffade: met; a regular past form.
bokade: booked; a regular past form.
väntade på: waited for; keep på with the verb.

pages.title: Textbook page practice: Det är viktigt att ha bra vänner
pages.intro: This is Maria’s letter to Lena inside the textbook plot. Use it as a model for an informal letter: greeting, important news, support and a closing.
pages.imageAlt: Textbook page 20, Det är viktigt att ha bra vänner, a letter from Maria to Lena
recallCues: She has something important to tell; it is about Andreas.
She says he booked a café table with Nora behind Lena’s back.
She asks Lena not to be angry with Nora.
Maria and Nora planned the date to show Lena the truth.
Maria offers help, then closes with a hug and her name.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.fi: Jag har något viktigt att berätta för dig. Det handlar om Andreas.
lines.en: I have something important to tell you. It is about Andreas.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.fi: Ni köpte ett stort hus tillsammans och har två barn men jag tycker inte att han är ärlig.
lines.en: You bought a big house together and have two children, but I do not think he is honest.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.fi: Ett nytt, mysigt kafé öppnar på fredag den 10 april och Andreas bokade bord. Han ska ha fika där med min vän Nora bakom din rygg.
lines.en: A new, cosy café opens on Friday 10 April, and Andreas booked a table. He is going to have coffee there with my friend Nora behind your back.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.fi: Bli inte arg på Nora! Hon visste inte att Andreas hade fru och barn. Hon är en snäll tjej och hon ska göra slut med Andreas på fredag.
lines.en: Do not be angry with Nora! She did not know that Andreas had a wife and children. She is a kind woman, and she will break up with Andreas on Friday.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.fi: Vi planerade den här dejten så att vi kan visa dig sanningen. Andreas ljuger! Jag finns här för dig om du behöver något.
lines.en: We planned this date so that we can show you the truth. Andreas is lying! I am here for you if you need anything.

listenQuestions.prompt: Why did Maria and Nora plan the date?
listenQuestions.explanation: Vi planerade den här dejten så att vi kan visa dig sanningen.

naturalNotes.source: Jag har något viktigt att berätta för dig.
naturalNotes.natural: Jag måste berätta en viktig sak.
naturalNotes.note: Both are natural. The source phrase is useful when you have important news.

hunt.label: Letter-phrase hunt
hunt.title: Find the useful phrases marked or underlined on the page.
hunt.instructions: These chunks tell the topic, refer to secrecy, and offer support.

spots.rule: Use det handlar om + topic: it is about …
A fixed phrase meaning behind your back.
A warm way to offer support.

sections.title: Put past events in order
body: A list becomes a story when the listener knows when things happened and in what order. Start with a time: igår, i lördags, förra veckan. Then guide the listener with först, sedan, efter det and till slut.

Swedish keeps the verb in the second position. If a time phrase takes the first position, the past-tense verb comes next and the subject follows: Förra veckan läste vi en bok. Do not say Förra veckan vi läste.

examples.fi: Förra veckan läste vi en bok.
examples.en: Last week we read a book.
examples.note: Time first changes the order to läste vi.

examples.fi: Först åt jag frukost. Sedan gick jag på bio. Efter det träffade jag en vän.
examples.en: First I ate breakfast. Then I went to the cinema. After that I met a friend.
examples.note: Three signposts make the order clear.

sections.memoryTip: TIME → VERB → PERSON: Förra veckan → läste → vi.
sections.tryIt: Say three true or invented events. Begin each line with Igår, Sedan or Efter det.

activity.label: Order or verb?
activity.title: What job does the first phrase do?
activity.instructions: Sort each phrase into a time anchor or an order signpost. Then say its complete model aloud.

items.why: Sedan moves to the next event.
Efter det links to the earlier event.

activity.summary: Put any one of these first, then put the verb second.

sections.title: Write to a friend
body: An informal letter sounds like a conversation. Begin with Hej + name. Share your news in short paragraphs. Ask one real question so your friend can answer. End warmly with Kram or Hälsningar and your name.
A diary records a day for yourself. A letter chooses news for another person. Both become easy to follow when you use time and order phrases.

examples.fi: I måndags började jag en ny kurs. Sedan träffade jag en vän.
examples.en: On Monday I started a new course. Then I met a friend.
examples.note: Two pieces of news in time order.

sections.title: Say what it is about
body: Use det handlar om when you name the topic or story of a book, film, letter or conversation. Learn it as one chunk. Handlar alone often means deals, but handlar om means is about.
Put the thing first, then handlar om, then the topic: Filmen handlar om vänskap.
sections.memoryTip: THING + handlar om + TOPIC. Keep om attached.
sections.tryIt: Name one film or book and say what it is about.

activity.label: What is it about?
activity.title: Match each thing with its topic
activity.instructions: Match the halves, then say every full sentence.
activity.pattern: handlar om stays together before the topic.

guided.hint: Put the time first and the past verb second.

writing.prompt: Write an informal letter to a friend about your week.
writing.situation: Your friend Sara asks: “Hur var din vecka?” (How was your week?) Write back with your news.
points: Describe at least two events from your week in a clear order.
Use an informal closing and your name.
writing.help: Hej Sara! · I måndags … · Först … · Sedan … · Efter det … · Vad gjorde du? · Hur var din vecka? · Kram, …
writing.model:
Hej Sara!
Tack för ditt brev. Min vecka var bra. I måndags tränade jag på gymmet. Sedan träffade jag en vän och vi drack kaffe tillsammans. I onsdags såg jag en rolig film hemma. Vad gjorde du i veckan?
Kram, Alex

assignment.title: Episode 8 mission: My weekend in order
assignment.instructions:
CORE: Tell a friend about last weekend in five to seven lines. Say when, and connect at least three events with först, sedan, efter det or till slut. Finish with how it was.

WRITE: Answer a friend in 40–70 words. Include a greeting, two events, one question and an informal closing.

RETURN: Tomorrow, tell three events again without looking.
assignment.model: I helgen träffade jag en vän. Först drack vi kaffe. Sedan gick vi på bio. Efter det åt vi middag tillsammans. Till slut gick jag hem. Det var en rolig helg.

takeaways: A time phrase can come first: Förra veckan läste vi en bok. The verb still comes second.
Order a past story with först, sedan, efter det and till slut.
Det handlar om tells the topic of a book, film or conversation.
A friendly letter has a greeting, news, a question and a warm closing.
